task.summary: Added a simple game HUD and split the health variable to maxHealth and currentHealth.
Positions of both the player and the goal/dungeon exit is now determined by the generator.
Extended a new Player class from the GameCharacter class. Created draw functions inside the Enemy and Player classes.
Basic goal function. New dungeon generates when player steps into the goal.
Redesigned attack move; attacking is now independent from positional movement controls.
Added the rock, paper, scissors elements for the game, including the color assignments.
Implemented the core combat mechanics of the game.
Added counters for the enemy types in the generator.
